body: CHANGELOG updated in PRRJECT_FATBABY: feat(newssite): earnings dates now shown on ticker pages (next upcoming + up to 4 most recent past, with status/timing) via the already-loaded earningscal.Store, previously only used on /section/earnings. Found and fixed a real data sourcing bug along the way: 61 of 363 stored earnings-calendar records had FiscalYear=0 (scanSecFilings didn't handle ExtractPeriod finding a quarter label but no explicit year in filing text). Fixed the extraction fallback (derive year from filing date), added a store-level filter for the now-orphaned bad-ID legacy records (append-only store can't delete, corrected records land under new IDs), and re-derived+corrected all 61 live records. New tests for both. PRRJECT_FATBABY 7fc2b54 + 95764ee.
